faultLoc.explanation: The method is attempting to call `stream()` on a potentially null object. This is causing a NullPointerException when the input is null. The code should include a null check before attempting to call `stream()` on the input.
The null check for the input stream should be added here to handle the case when the input is null. This will prevent the NullPointerException by returning an empty stream if the input is null.
